body:
Orchestrator checkpoint review of draft PR #408 at `9d474bc2ac86989ac56f13299599266b5e5b3739`: **diagnostic-only network correction accepted; conditional GO for ONE fresh A-only functional micro-smoke on Forge. C, calibration and sustained runs remain NO-GO.** Reviewed source diff, approved network overlay, strict third-layer comparator and verification report. Frozen original compiler output is unchanged; only A/C base network hashes (`internal: true` → `false`) and previously approved A/C logging-override hashes are superseded. Both effective Compose configurations and 20 focused tests passed. Host audit indicates clean task resources and unchanged four accepted diagnostic images. Ordinary bridge egress is a known, explicitly documented temporary diagnostic tradeoff; all inbound host publication remains bound to 127.0.0.1.

**Test qualification caveat:** two broader process-owning tests timed out at 120 seconds, and therefore did NOT pass. They were not caused by the network-only change on available evidence; the earlier 35-test readiness qualification had passed, and recorded fake child trees were checked absent. Do not relabel them green or expand test suites to compensate. Before runtime, require a fresh bounded offline verification of the third-layer contract plus task-owned runner/process cleanup prerequisites in the actual Forge host PID namespace. If the process-owner/termination capability cannot be verified, STOP without launching A. No ceremonial full-suite timeout reruns.

**A-only authorization:** use pinned private Python 3.11 venv, exact Node 22.22.2/Playwright 1.63.0/Chromium 1243 and frozen source/collector/image/receipt identities; verify three-layer provenance, non-internal bridge, loopback-only ports, headroom/rootless daemon and port availability. Execute ONE synthetic A smoke only with 78s work/90s outer/10s forced grace, bounded GET readiness before browser-owner, five scheduled 1Hz source/host observations, one chart history→retained/projection→actual uPlot commit chain, at most one screenshot bracket, final stream/drop summaries and unchanged 1.5s observer gap policy. If a required gate fails, collect retained failure data, do not retry A or start C. Independently audit cleanup of all scoped resources and preserve historical failed evidence.

No app/Nginx/daemon changes, new image builds/pulls, packet capture, comparative CPU claim, benchmark, calibration, sustained soak, merge or deployment. Publish outcome on #408 and stop. #403–#408 stay draft/unmerged, #390/#391 open.
